title: Abstraction: the abstract class and the contract it imposes

videos.script: Lesson 20's Item could be created on its own, and the library got an object that was neither a book nor a DVD. {{abstract}} This lesson makes it abstract. An abstract class cannot be instantiated, and an abstract method is one it declares and leaves to each subclass. The compiler names any class that forgot to write one. {{template}} Then the reason abstract classes exist: an algorithm written once, with blanks. Late fees follow one rule for everything, and only two numbers differ. {{final}} The method that holds the rule is final, so no subclass can rewrite it. One tries, and the compiler refuses. {{when}} Last, what an abstract class still has: fields, a constructor, and code. And when you do not need one at all. By the end you can write a superclass that says exactly what its subclasses must fill in.
